2nd son.bio: Toronto producer and multi-instrumentalist 2nd Son makes soul-, funk-, R&B- and hip-hop-informed music and is known for a long-running creative partnership with Canadian singer a l l i e.

8ond.bio: Toronto-born rapper and singer 8OND makes melodic Canadian hip-hop shaped by atmospheric hooks, laid-back production and a grassroots performance career built in the city.

b00sted.bio: Vancouver pop-rap artist B00sted, born Keegan Jaeckel, blends hip-hop flows with melodic pop and alternative-rock influences in a growing West Coast Canadian catalogue.

baby nova.bio: Nova Scotia-born singer-songwriter Baby Nova, born Kayleigh O'Connor, makes dramatic Canadian dream-pop and alternative pop built around cinematic production and emotionally exposed writing.

bdice.bio: Vancouver recording artist, producer and director Bdice makes Canadian hip-hop while also working behind the scenes as an engineer, producer and music-video creator.

benstar.bio: Markham, Ontario artist Benstar is a Canadian contemporary-R&B singer, songwriter and producer whose independent catalogue centers on melodic vocals and modern R&B production.

big jacks.bio: Toronto DJ, producer and curator Big Jacks is a Canadian music figure known for deep R&B and hip-hop knowledge, vinyl culture and co-founding the Toronto-based GGBR Records & Tapes.

big sproxx.bio: Toronto hip-hop producer Big Sproxx is a Canadian beatmaker, engineer and Freedom Writers member known for sample-driven production and collaborations across the city's independent rap scene.

brass tacks.bio: Toronto hip-hop crew Brass Tacks, built around Battle Cat and Diamond Eye's, emerged from the city's 1990s underground with progressive production, battle-rap roots and independent vinyl releases.

blesse.bio: Montréal trio blesse grew out of Zen Bamboo and blends francophone alternative rock with indie, bedroom-pop and hyperpop influences in a collaborative Québec project.
